RFAL. Note the last commit, where I'm asking of what the expected semantics are - I see range dels in the exported SST even though they're out of time bounds. This happens - sometimes - regardless of what `exportAllVersions` is set to.

I'd like to take this opportunity to improve comments (and if there's a bug, fix it of course)
I think the comment is actually there, I am still parsing it but things are maybe starting to make sense (https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/C02FTAH8JCT/p1660721713799309)

Oof. This can't be entirely right.
It's not right, since this was exporting tombstones that it shouldn't have. Stay tuned for the updated numbers.

The new results are in. Unfortunately they're not much better. For example, this one has a 9k% regression ``` MVCCExportToSST/numKeys=64/numRevisions=1/exportAllRevisions=true/numRangeKeys=100 ``` Here are some profiles. From top level, can already see lots of time in `rangekey.coalesce`: Zooming into the middle icicle, get more of the same basically: I don't understand why the absolute time with 100 rangekeys gets *better* when we increase `numRevisions`, though. Surely we're doing more work when numRevisions=10 compared to numRevisions=1? ``` MVCCExportToSST/numKeys=64/numRevisions=1/exportAllRevisions=true/X-24 87.8µs ± 1% 8064.0µs ± 1% +9086.81% (p=0.008 n=5+5) MVCCExportToSST/numKeys=64/numRevisions=10/exportAllRevisions=true/X-24 347µs ± 1% 5331µs ± 1% +1437.46% (p=0.008 n=5+5) MVCCExportToSST/numKeys=64/numRevisions=100/exportAllRevisions=true/X-24 1.63ms ± 1% 7.00ms ± 1% +330.29% (p=0.008 n=5+5) ```

Filed cockroachdb/pebble#1907 for removing that middle icicle, which I think we can do.

An aside: I think there is still low-hanging fruit down in Pebble in the 1+ range keys cases. Only the 0 range keys case is very well optimized on the Pebble side.

> Surely we're doing more work when numRevisions=10 compared to numRevisions=1?
 
Hmm, yeah, I don't have a explanation for that.
